# nod

> nod is a free, MIT-licensed, suckless-style notification daemon for X11, written in C11 by Matteo Merola. It implements the Desktop Notifications Specification 1.2 over native D-Bus.

nod renders notifications as folding cards using CUI and SDL3. Features include hover-to-unfold stacks, action buttons, animated entrance and exit, swipe dismissal, focused-monitor selection with XRandR, Xresources colors and fonts with live reload, startup configuration in ${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/nod/config.ini, scheduled do not disturb, app muting, an XEmbed tray toggle, and nod-dnd / nod-send scripts.

nod targets X11. The mwm tray applet can read the latest 50 notifications from in-memory history, including those received during DND. History excludes transient messages and notifications from muted apps.
